## Overview

Moving a validated workflow from `MockSlurmBackend` onto a university or cloud
HPC cluster requires reproducible compiled containers, firewall-friendly SSH
orchestration, and (for interactive dashboards) non-blocking Shiny modules.
This vignette walks through each piece end-to-end.

## 1. Scanning Project Environments & Compiled Toolchains

`scan_project_env()` inspects `renv.lock`, `DESCRIPTION`, and R/Rmd/Quarto
scripts to build a unified dependency manifest and infer required compiled
toolchains (`cpp`, `cmdstan`, `rstan`, `tmb`, `jags`, `linear_algebra`,
`spatial`, `http_ssl`, `graphics`, `arrow`):

```{r scan-env}
library(slurmpilot)

proj_dir <- tempfile("sp_proj_")
dir.create(file.path(proj_dir, "R"), recursive = TRUE)

writeLines(c(
  "Package: multilevelstudy",
  "Version: 0.1.0",
  "Imports: lme4, Rcpp, RTMB, dplyr"
), file.path(proj_dir, "DESCRIPTION"))

writeLines(c(
  "library(cmdstanr)",
  "library(ggplot2)",
  "x <- tibble::tibble(a = 1:3)"
), file.path(proj_dir, "R", "fit_models.R"))

env <- scan_project_env(path = proj_dir)
print(env)
env$toolchains
names(toolchain_registry())
```

## 2. Building Reproducible Apptainer `.def` Recipes

`build_apptainer_def()` generates a deterministic Apptainer/Singularity recipe
pinned to `rocker/r-ver:<r_version>` with minimal `apt-get` system packages,
C++17 `Makevars`, single-threaded BLAS/OpenMP defaults (preventing thread
oversubscription across SLURM array jobs), optional CmdStan installation, and
`%test` verification:

```{r apptainer}
def <- build_apptainer_def(env, r_version = "4.4.1")
print(def)
cat(paste(head(def$recipe, 32L), collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

## 3. Rendering Hardened SLURM `sbatch` Scripts

`render_sbatch_script()` renders a POSIX-safe array script with strict defense
against newline, shell metacharacter, and path-traversal injection. Surgical
retries compress target indices cleanly with `format_slurm_array_indices()`:

```{r sbatch}
res <- resource_spec(
  n_tasks = 100L,
  chunk_size = 10L,
  mem_mb = 4096L,
  time_minutes = 60,
  cpus_per_task = 2L,
  partition = "general",
  account = "quant_lab",
  max_concurrent = 5L
)

sb <- render_sbatch_script(
  job_name = "bayesian_dsem",
  resources = res,
  work_dir = "/scratch/researcher/bayesian_dsem",
  container_sif = "/scratch/containers/slurmpilot_env.sif",
  modules = c("apptainer/1.3"),
  mail_type = "FAIL"
)

cat(sb$text)
```

## 4. Remote SSH/SLURM Orchestration (`SlurmSshBackend`)

`SlurmSshBackend` communicates exclusively over non-interactive `ssh` and `scp`
(`BatchMode=yes`, explicit `--` option delimiters, dangerous directive blocking,
and bounded exponential backoff for transient network blips) — avoiding ZeroMQ
firewall issues on university clusters.

Use `dry_run = TRUE` to inspect staged files and exact SSH/SCP commands offline:

```{r ssh-dry}
tmp_stage <- tempfile("sp_ssh_stage_")
ssh_be <- slurm_ssh_backend(
  host = "hpc.university.edu",
  user = "researcher",
  remote_dir = "/scratch/researcher/slurmpilot",
  local_stage_dir = tmp_stage,
  partition = "general",
  container_sif = "/scratch/containers/slurmpilot_env.sif",
  ssh_max_retries = 3L,
  dry_run = TRUE
)

dry_job <- slurm_submit(
  backend = ssh_be,
  fun = function(x) mean(stats::rnorm(x$n)),
  args_list = lapply(1:10, function(i) list(n = 500)),
  resources = resource_spec(n_tasks = 10L, chunk_size = 5L, mem_mb = 2048L, time_minutes = 15),
  name = "dry_run_demo"
)

print(dry_job)
names(dry_job$meta$dry_run_commands)
```

`slurmpilot` also exports hardened SLURM output parsers covering stepped array
expressions, per-CPU/per-node memory suffixes (`Mc`/`Mn`), and `.batch`
sub-step consolidation:

```{r parsers}
parse_slurm_array_spec("1-10:2,15%4")
parse_slurm_mem(c("1024K", "2.5G", "0.5T", "100Mc", "200Mn"))

parse_squeue_output("482910_1|RUNNING|04:20|cn042|None\n482910_[2-4]|PENDING|0:00||(Priority)")

parse_sacct_output(paste(
  "482910_1|COMPLETED|00:08:15||0:0",
  "482910_1.batch|COMPLETED|00:08:15|1536M|0:0",
  "482910_2|OUT_OF_MEMORY|00:02:10||0:125",
  "482910_2.batch|OUT_OF_MEMORY|00:02:10|4Gc|0:125",
  sep = "\n"
))

unlink(c(proj_dir, tmp_stage), recursive = TRUE)
```

## 5. Non-Blocking `bslib` / Shiny Offload Modules

Drop `mod_hpc_submit_ui/server` and `mod_hpc_monitor_ui/server` into any
`bslib` app to run micro-pilots and array jobs in background OS processes while
keeping the Shiny UI responsive at all times:

```r
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(slurmpilot)

ui <- page_fluid(
  theme = bs_theme(version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly"),
  mod_hpc_submit_ui("submit", show_fault_toggle = TRUE),
  mod_hpc_monitor_ui("monitor")
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  backend <- mock_slurm_backend(max_workers = 2L)

  submit <- mod_hpc_submit_server(
    id = "submit",
    backend = backend,
    fun = function(x) mean(stats::rnorm(x$n)),
    args_builder = function(n_tasks) lapply(seq_len(n_tasks), function(i) list(n = 1000))
  )

  monitor <- mod_hpc_monitor_server(
    id = "monitor",
    job = submit$job,
    auto_collect = TRUE,
    simplify = TRUE
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

Run the bundled interactive demo studio via `slurmpilot::run_demo_app()`.
